description: The settings pop-out is undecorated (spec 2026-08-20), so it has no OS title bar to drag by and its `data-tauri-drag-region` elements stand in for one. `core:default` does NOT include `core:window:allow-start-dragging`, so without this the attribute is silently inert and the window cannot be moved at all — there is no taskbar entry to recover it from either. Granted to the settings window alone: the brain host is hidden and the overlays are click-through, so neither has any business starting a window drag.
